title: Tradeasy; Sales & Inventory Management System
description: A platform which customers, suppliers and the company together which optimize the sales and inventory management process.
impact: Optimized stock management by 35% and improved supplier collaboration for local SMEs.
detailedDescription: Tradeasy is a comprehensive suite built for modern retail management. It features real-time inventory tracking, automated supplier ordering, and detailed sales analytics. The system integrates with Stripe for secure payments and utilizes a scalable PostgreSQL database.

title: RiseUp Mora Web Portal
description: A web application developed for the career fair organized by IEEE student branch of University of Moratuwa in 2023
impact: Empowered 1,200+ undergraduates to connect with top-tier tech recruiters seamlessly.
detailedDescription: Developed for the internal career fair at the University of Moratuwa, this portal handled thousands of student profiles and company applications. It features a custom appointment booking system and automated CV screening tools.

title: AIESEC One
description: A platform which optimizes and manages the internal processes; opportunities, resources and mambers of AIESEC in Sri Lanka.
impact: Digitalized member logistics for 10+ local committees, saving 40+ administrative hours weekly.
detailedDescription: AIESEC One is an internal ERP designed to streamline operations for the world's largest youth-led organization. It manages recruitment cycles, international exchange opportunities, and financial reporting across Sri Lanka.

title: e- Doctor
description: This is a UI Design created for a medical application which facilitates channelling of doctors online.
impact: Designed a telemedicine interface that reduced booking time by 50% in user testing.
detailedDescription: A high-fidelity mockup for a futuristic telemedicine platform. The design emphasizes ease of use for elder patients and features integrated video consultation interfaces and health tracking dashboards.

title: Narcotic Drugs Protector
description: This is a semi-automated system developed for hospitals to enhance the security and management of narcotic medications.
impact: Reduced drug shrinkage and unauthorized access by implementing RFID tracking.
detailedDescription: An IoT-based solution for critical medication security. Using Arduino and RFID authentication, this system ensures that only authorized medical staff can access high-risk narcotics, while logging every transaction in real-time.

title: Weather App
description: This is a mini project developed using Angular 18 to identify weather condition of cities in the world.
impact: Created a lightweight, real-time dashboard for localized weather insights.
detailedDescription: Built on Angular 18, this application provides hyper-local weather data across the globe. It leverages the OpenWeatherAPI for high-accuracy forecasts and features a clean, mobile-first design.
